summary_en: 661,706 ordinary shares to be cancelled. Post-cancellation issued shares: 6,600,000 (treasury: 573,192 shares, 8.68% of post-cancel base). Effective 2026-08-31. Shares acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2021-02-05 and 2025-11-07, and open-market purchase on TSE.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-06, Yokohama Maruuo's board resolved to cancel 661,706 treasury ordinary shares pursuant to Company Law Article 178. The shares were acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2021-02-05 and 2025-11-07, and through open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Cancellation is scheduled for 2026-08-31. Post-cancellation, issued shares will total 6,600,000, with remaining treasury shares of 573,192 (8.68% of the post-cancel base). The cancellation ratio is 9.11% of pre-cancellation issued shares.
